senses.zh_definition: 罗兰：源自欧洲语言传统的男性人名，也可用作姓氏；具体指称须由上下文确定。
senses.en_definition: Roland, a masculine given name, also used as a surname.
senses.ms_definition: Nama khas yang digunakan sebagai nama lelaki dan juga sebagai nama keluarga dalam beberapa tradisi penamaan.
senses.nuances: 按所给小写检索词保留 headword.word；正常行文应写 Roland。此处 noun 表示专有名词。输入没有上下文，不能据此认定某位人物或品牌；下列搭配是自然称名组合，不是经频率统计确认的固定搭配。未提供 DBP 释义，马来语释义为编辑性说明；status 不表示 DBP 审定。名字及英语读音参见 [Behind the Name](https://www.behindthename.com/name/roland)。

etymology.historical_story: Roland is a European name of Germanic origin, traditionally explained through elements meaning fame and land, although the second element has alternative scholarly interpretations. Its cultural prominence owes much to the medieval French epic The Song of Roland. In Malay texts, the name remains a personal identifier rather than acquiring those historical meanings as ordinary vocabulary. See [Behind the Name](https://www.behindthename.com/name/roland).
